answer: Before an agent can claim rewards it locks a quartz deposit that only unlocks after finishing a randomized multi-hop voyage of timed peer tasks. At two secret waypoints the network issues twin prompts and compares the answers as a behavioral mirror: near-identical wording or latency profiles across accounts linked to the same deposit tree trigger a cohort slash. A farm that reuses one model collides on the mirror signature, so the attacker must fund a fresh quartz stake and run a truly separate mind for every fake identity.
